acceptanceCriteria: The Stop adapter output lists selected tests, unwitnessed ranges and mutation verdicts for new tests, or NOT_RUN with a reason for each missing part.
A fixture proves a tautological new test is reported as killing no mutant.
The spec records how the mutation budget fits the hook timeout, with a stable requirement ID.
body: Filed 2026-09-27 from the owner's request to research Corvint integrations with large productivity gains. Agent-written tests that pass regardless of the code under test are an expensive failure. Three existing verbs answer it: `corvint affected` (tests this diff needs), `corvint witness` (changed surface no test exercises) and `corvint prove --mutate` (test-kills-mutant rows; up to eight single-operator mutants per changed file under a 30-minute invocation budget). Proposal: the Stop adapter composes them into one advisory done-list, running `--mutate` only for test files added in the session to stay inside the hook timeout or deferring it to an explicit command. Advisory only; it must not block Stop or claim authority. Any productivity gain is a hypothesis until measured; `corvint surprise` and `corvint necessity` supply the measure.
title: hosts: `Stop` hook reports the done-list: affected tests, unwitnessed lines, and new tests that kill no mutant
